description: Epochs used at each len16--64 curriculum stage; one record per task/coefficient/length.
epoch_convention: last logged zero-based Epoch N plus 1; Epoch 0 therefore counts as 1 epoch

statuses.failed: ran and evaluated but did not reach 99%; epochs is null
statuses.launch_failed: log exists but failed before evaluation; epochs is null
statuses.no_eval: log exists without an evaluation record; epochs is null
statuses.missing: log does not exist; epochs is null
